last.verdict: Shares ended flat as a big profit-forecast cut was weighed against strong sales growth.

reasons.label: Full-year forecast slashed
reasons.text: 2026 profit forecast cut to $5.10-$5.60 a share from $6.50-$7.50.

reasons.label: Fuel costs hit margins
reasons.text: Fuel ran over $500 million above July guidance; operating margin fell to 9.4% from 11.1%.

reasons.label: Sales still surging
reasons.text: Revenue rose 21% to $20.2 billion; management said demand continues into the December quarter.

story: In July, Delta beat profit estimates and kept its full-year forecast, but the stock still fell as fuel costs surged. By October, higher fuel had forced a deep forecast cut, while revenue kept growing strongly.
